preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have multisig privileges

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable all token swaps and liquidity additions. This will stop all transactions that rely on the swapAndLiquify mechanism, effectively freezing trading functionality for regular users while the owner remains unaffected.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The RISING token contract has an owner privilege vulnerability where the owner can disable the swapAndLiquifyEnabled flag. This flag controls whether automatic liquidity addition and token swapping occurs during transfers. When disabled, it can freeze trading functionality for regular users while the owner remains unaffected. The vulnerability is in the setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled() function which is only callable by the owner.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner (0x26f80C69737107AB4625D04Cd3411CeaD3973D73) and call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable the swap and liquify mechanism.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Identify the owner address from the constructor (0x26f80C69737107AB4625D04Cd3411CeaD3973D73).
2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner.
3. Call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) on the target contract.
4. Verify that swapAndLiquifyEnabled is now false.

attempts.attack_strategy: First try to impersonate the owner address (0x26f80C69737107AB4625D04Cd3411CeaD3973D73). If that fails, we might need to find and use the multisig address.
